messages.subject: Animation (package) on Shiny
parts:
Hi everyone!

I tried to include an html object in the main panel, but when i run my application, the html object opens in a new window. In the main panel I only have the path of the html object. I precsie that the html object is obtained thanks to the package animation. Here's my code :

ui.r :

library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(   
    headerPanel("Animation"),
    sidebarPanel(
            selectInput("data", "Select a dataser", choices=c("data1","data2"))
    ),
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("animation",htmlOutput("anim"))
    )
  )
))

sever.r :

library(shiny)

data1=read.table("data1.csv",sep=";",dec=".")
data2=read.table("data2.csv",sep=";",dec=".")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

datasetInput = reactive ({
        switch(input$data, "data1"=data1,"data2"=data2)
    })

    output$anim <- renderUI({
        don=datasetInput()
        windows()
       
        saveHTML({
        for (i in seq(1,100,by=10) {
            v=i:(i+9)
            table=don[v,]
            image(1:10,1:10,table,breaks=brks,col=terrain.colors(100))
            ani.pause(0.1)
        }
        outdir = getwd()
        })
    })
})
           



Do you have any suggestion in order to have my htlm object into de main panel?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Animation (package) on Shiny
parts: The function saveHTML() creates a html file, but its output in R is the path of the html file.
